config.userAgent: User agent for the main provider
config.backupUserAgent: User agent for the backup provider
config.standbySeconds: Seconds without a viewer before standby
config.autoFailover: Switch to the backup automatically when the main provider is dead
config.backupMaxConnections: Connections allowed at the backup provider
config.backupScanWithLive: Allow one scan capture beside the live at a single-connection provider
config.audioAutoCopy: Channels whose audio is copied when it is AAC stereo (| separated, * for all)
config.deadAfterSeconds: Seconds of silence in front of viewers before the automatic switch
config.troubleDeadSeconds: Seconds of silence that count as trouble
config.unstableAfterSeconds: Seconds of stuttering before a proposal
config.unstableWindowSeconds: Window over which stuttering bursts add up (s)
config.trialAfterSeconds: Seconds of stuttering before a background trial of the other provider
config.trialGapSecondsPerMinute: Seconds per minute the other provider must gain to be better
config.trialRatio: Times less stuttering the other provider must show
config.minKbps: Bitrate under which no media is flowing (kb/s)
config.blockedTerms: Terms that mark an adult channel (comma separated)
config.homeBonus: Score bonus for a preferred country
config.foreignCodes: Country prefixes treated as foreign (comma separated)
config.variantWeights: Variant weights (raw, vip, fhd, hd, exact)
